plugin.name: Fourth Wall · Direct Character Chat
plugin.description: Open an independent fourth-wall conversation inside the current Tavo chat. Reads saved assistant replies and accessible long-term memories, detects characters from card names and chapter headers, and lets you select one in a single chat window. Only relevant snippets and memories are sent to the configured model on each request. Original messages are never edited; separate lounge logs are stored in chat-scoped plugin files. Requires Advanced Rendering. Test in a backup chat first.
releaseNotes.1_1_1: Fix missing mandatory localization declaration that prevented v1.1.0 installation on Tavo 1.10. Add bilingual resources and localized UI. Preserve native chat reading, single-window selection and memory retrieval.
